Needs changes before merge.

The AccessKit changes expose the Properties pane, selected G-code row, and tool icons. The moved layout checks preserve the existing assertions. No golden files or snapshot PNGs changed.

I ran the checks locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-2090`. The trial merge with upstream/main `c86d6db351c863e5bbcd98dd278d667c452eb78d` had no conflicts. I did not use a GitHub runner.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| UI library and six mapped integration suites: `cargo test -p camcraft-ui ... --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib -- --test-threads=6` from `crates/ui` | 874 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored |
| `boundary` | 3 passed |
| `boundary_picks` | 6 passed |
| `sinker_setup` | 2 passed |
| `tap_hand` | 3 passed |
| `theme_files` | 14 passed |
| `waterjet_tool` | 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed, no warnings |
| Isolated `layout_page_tool` test | Failed again |

The library failure was:

```text
---- egui_app::tests::page_layout::layout_page_tool stdout ----
panicked at crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout.rs:48:13:
Tool page: no widget labelled "Edit"
```

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout.rs:161`: Update the tool layout test for the current tool Properties page. Upstream now shows the tool fields directly. This new test still expects the former `Edit` control and library actions. It fails after the clean trial merge. Keep meaningful layout assertions and run the UI library suite again. This test comes from the included parent #1996.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs:82`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for the UI change. The body has no screenshots. Use the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link the images in the body. Do not add image evidence to the PR branch.
3. `AGENTS.md:593`: Add the exact line `Process change: yes` to the PR body. The current diff includes changes to root `AGENTS.md` and `crates/ui/AGENTS.md` from #1996. The required process declaration is absent. If the parent merges first, check the remaining diff again.

Notes: #1996 is still open, and the body identifies it as the parent. The PR does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge or collision checks. The G-code change only exposes row selection to AccessKit. This is not a safety-tier review. I did not repeat mutations or change code. The changed pinning tests passed in the library run. The six ignored tests stayed ignored; I did not run pixel snapshots or manual image capture.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the three findings from the latest review.

1. Updated `layout_page_tool` for the direct tool fields. It checks field order and Properties pane bounds. The old test failed. Moving Delete above the heading also failed. Restoring the layout passed.
2. Added before and after images to the PR body. The images are only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. A body check fails when either image link is removed. Both restored links pass. The images show no visible change from the accessibility wrapper.
3. Added the exact line `Process change: yes` to the PR body. The body check fails without the line and passes with it.

Merged `upstream/main` without conflicts to include the tool page that the review tested.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. The UI library had 875 passed tests and 6 ignored tests. All six mapped integration suites passed.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed without warnings.

New head: `58ba8b91746a0b5e579b8e226bd5eb9338d4756f`.

Please review this head again. The PR remains a draft.

The only conflict was in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`.
I kept both sides' test modules and the shared anchor helper.
No application logic needed manual resolution.

The tests include `layout_page_tool`, `ribbon_text_rows_stack_top_to_bottom`, `browser_tree_and_pane_follow_theme_tokens`, and `large_tree_eye_clicks_stay_in_their_rows`.
Removing the four test modules made the discovery check fail: 0 of 31 required tests remained.
Restoring the modules made it pass: all 31 tests returned.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed.
The UI library had 930 passed tests and 6 ignored tests.
The six selected integration suites had 30 passed tests.
`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed without warnings.
`git diff --check upstream/main` passed.

I returned the PR to draft before the push. I left all labels unchanged.
No screenshots, logs, or evidence files were added to the branch.
The process version matches main.

The merge batch on main `aaddb2d48` did not merge this PR. The PR conflicts with main in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`: main added `mod stock_fit;` (from #1685) and this PR added `mod page_layout;` and `mod anchors;` at the same place. The resolution keeps the three lines, but it is a hand edit, so it is a DELTA refresh. The label is now `conflicts` in place of `merge-ready`. Merge `origin/main` into the branch, then ask for a delta review of the merge.

Resolved the conflict requested in the latest comment.

Merged upstream/main at `4b7a6b1e87d3db22222ea3132f95a45f20a45f8a`.
Kept `stock_fit`, `page_layout`, and `anchors` in the test module list.
The discovery pin finds all 21 layout and stock-fit tests.
Removing either test module fails the pin. Removing `anchors` fails compilation. Restoring each module passes.

The automatic merge also left incompatible UI test queries.
The outside-click test now reads live button and menu bounds.
`the_viewport_row_is_inert_and_the_door_dismisses_outside` pins this correction.
The old code fails compilation. The corrected test passes.

The tool layout and stock-fit tests now select Delete in Properties.
`layout_page_tool` and `stock_fit_controls_follow_the_selected_shape` pin this correction.
The old global queries fail with duplicate Delete buttons. The scoped queries pass.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed.
The UI library passed 948 tests, with 6 ignored tests.
The six selected integration suites passed 30 tests.
UI clippy passed without warnings. The diff check passed.

I returned the PR to draft before the plain push. I left all labels unchanged.
No screenshots, logs, or review evidence were committed.
